profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer  |  Solution Focused ✸ Expediting Workflows for Greater Productivity
profile.summary:
Senior Technology Engineer with diverse extensive experience architecting solutions for companies in professional services, technology, manufacturing, hospitality and telecommunications. Hands-on experience in consulting on business challenges and developing technology solutions for importing/exporting data and data analytics, and expediting workflow. 
➤ Subject Matter Expert – scaling processes to handle larger amounts of data, running simulations, and to speed output for end users.
➤ Highly Analytical Problem Solver – hypothesizing and asking questions to decipher root causes and to develop an optimal solution and educate the end-user/client.
➤ Global Data Standards –  working knowledge and experience in managing and interpreting data from different countries and continents, including US, UK, Sweden, and Asia
➤  Approachable and Dependable Team Member – coaching and mentoring junior associates, and building relationships cross-functionally with other departments. 
➤  Self-Motivated and Driven – mastering new languages to expedite development and workarounds to problems.
➤ Multi-lingual/Multi-cultural – proficiency in English, Malay, Mandarin, and Cantonese.
➤ Mentoring Youth about STEM – coached a technology student team, winning a SC Regional Championship.  

TECHNOLOGY EXPERTISE
✸ Web Technologies: React.JS, HTML, CSS, GraphQL, Consul, JQuery, Knockout
✸ Languages: C#, JavaScript, Java, Python
✸ Frameworks: .net, AWS, NHibernate, Autofac
✸ IDE/GUI Tools: Visual Studio, Android Studio, SourceTree
✸ Databases: SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, Couchbase
✸ Tools: Team City, Swagger, ANTS Profiler, Windbg, Splunk, JIRA, BitBucket
✸ Unit Testing Framework: XUnit

✍ Invite you to connect with me on LinkedIn.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Promoted multiple times demonstrating expertise, initiative and drive in supporting the company’s growth and providing quality service to Client companies, e.g., in manufacturing and hospitality industry to quickly and accurately perform Salary and Compensation planning. 
► Took initiative and proposed UI facelift to avoid major rewrite and regression test, saving company significant time and expenses.
► Developed custom tools to shorten client compensation planning by helping client simulate the what-if before actual implementation.
► Proposed a solution to existing system architecture for computing salary data for a large client with 400k employees and with a few enhancements and optimizations, the system is now able to support over 500k users.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
► Implemented and maintained microservice api in AWS and on-prem and provided seamless transition from legacy environment to AWS.
► Resolved escalation defect and client work orders using creative custom tools or workaround
► Implemented and maintained Real Time Data Warehouse data and schema synchronization between transaction data store and analytics data warehouse
► Mentored and onboarded new team member to ramp up with domain knowledge

positions.title: Director of IT
positions.description:
Overhauled the technology of document management software for a growing legal services company while minimizing client impact and maintaining the company’s revenues and profit margins.  Hired and managed a team of 6 programmers. Managed professional services, i.e., Cost Recovery, Docket integration: scoping, statement of work, and budgeting.
► Designed, developed and tested new document management and automated document indexing system in C#.
► Led the development and formation of team for eFiling solution for multiple states including TX, CA and FL.
► Formed and managed a team to convert Excel inventory worksheet to custom content management system to increase accuracy and efficiency of content acquisitions team.
► Established data recovery plan by deploying a passive data center off-site using real-time file replication and SQL log shipping.

positions.title: Software Programmer
positions.description: Developed online wakeup call website and architected application to intake web orders into serial port command to phone system. Developed and tested the wakeup call application and proprietary language.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Mentoring and coaching a community-based FTC team, the Aztecs, made up of 14 student members. Inspiring students to pursue STEM fields such as Computer Science and Engineering. 
► Coach students on coding using Java and Android Studio and understanding the engineering process.   
► Helped the team achieve 2nd highest scoring team at the 2020-2021 SC Regional Championship.
